Hello, I am Max. My white water bottle is beside my lunch box. The lunch box is blue.

I am Nia. I like green best. My favourite green T-shirt has a little white bird on it.

Hi, I am Owen. Green is my favourite colour, too. I have a green ruler and a black pencil case.

Dear Ruby,

Our library club is looking for a new animal story to read together. We meet on Thursdays at Hill School. I remember that you read many books about birds. Can you suggest a good one for our group? We need at least two copies so we can share them.

Leo

Dear Leo,

You could try The Little Bird House. It is about two children who build a home for an injured bird. I have two copies, and you can borrow both. I can bring them to your school on Friday after my swimming lesson. Please keep them clean.

Ruby

Welcome to the school reading room. Six round tables are for students. Near the window is a long brown desk for Mrs Snow. She helps us find books and checks them when we borrow them.

A label on the bag says "Class Five" but has no name. If it is yours, come to Mrs Snow after class. When you borrow a book from this room, please **return** it within two weeks.

I am Mia and I am thirteen. I study in Class Seven. I enjoy stories and films, but my favourite activity is writing stories. I write about small things that happen at home. My brother likes reading my stories, but he does not write any himself.

Mr Lake knows where the books are, but he also listens to our suggestions. He has put a small box by his desk for book requests. He does not teach our history class. Ms Wood is our history teacher. We can ask Mr Lake for help whenever we cannot find a book.
